findings.source_en: Ah, I remember bowing at these feet once.
findings.ar: آه، أتذكّر أنني انحنيتُ أمام هذه القدمين ذات مرة.
findings.issue: Demonstrative does not agree with the dual قدمين. Same defect as the FootWash copy of this line (chunk 51, DD200501...); both keys need the fix.
findings.suggested_ar: آه، أتذكّر أنني انحنيتُ أمام هاتين القدمين ذات مرة.

findings.issue: 'Helped' is hedged; أصلح asserts a cure and loses the understatement. Duplicate of chunk 51's 4A6AC0D5... key.
findings.suggested_ar: ربما كان ذلك ليخفّف… من حالته.

findings.issue: Unstated subject in this foot-washing scene is the feet (قدمان, feminine dual), but the adjective is masculine singular and matches no antecedent the scene supplies. Duplicate of chunk 51's ABB30A53... key.
Same masculine-singular agreement against a feminine-dual antecedent (the feet). Duplicate of chunk 51's 03621F58... key.

findings.source_en: It’s… as if I can feel the Blessed Mether’s presence.
findings.ar: إنه… وكأنني أشعر بحضور الأُمَّهة المباركة.
findings.issue: إنه… و + كأنني strands a pronoun with no predicate and then starts a new clause with a spurious و. Meaning survives, but the sentence does not parse cleanly when read aloud.
findings.suggested_ar: الأمر… وكأنني أشعر بحضور الأُمَّهة المباركة.
